hard-attention with character-based LSTM seems the most promising architecture for character-level representation in neural machine translation for morphologically rich languages.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice of the encoder-level representation model is crucial for morphologically rich language translation.
the choice of neural architecture and the type of attention mechanism have a great impact on the quality of the learned representations.
character-based models are able to capture morphological information and can be used as a viable alternative to word-based models.
